mapper.select: SELECT questionId, MAX(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS accepted, MAX(CASE WHEN status IN (0, 1) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS pending FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND questionId IN (SELECT id FROM question WHERE isDelete = 0) GROUP BY questionId

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') AS day, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, SUM(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS acceptedCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(createTime, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY day
SELECT COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptedCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId}

SELECT language, COUNT(*) AS submitCount, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS acceptedCount, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ${acceptedSql} THEN questionId END) AS solvedCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} GROUP BY language ORDER BY submitCount DESC, language

SELECT questionId, createTime AS solvedTime, language, attemptNo AS attempts FROM ( SELECT questionId, createTime, language, attemptNo, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY questionId ORDER BY attemptNo) AS acceptedRank FROM ( SELECT questionId, createTime, language, status, judgeInfo, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY questionId ORDER BY createTime, id) AS attemptNo FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND questionId IN (SELECT id FROM question WHERE isDelete = 0) ) numbered WHERE ${acceptedSql} ) accepted WHERE acceptedRank = 1 ORDER BY solvedTime DESC, questionId DESC

SELECT HOUR(createTime) AS hour, COUNT(*) AS submitCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND createTime >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} - 1 DAY) GROUP BY HOUR(createTime)

SELECT status, SUBSTRING_INDEX(TRIM(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(judgeInfo, '$.message'))), '\n', 1) AS message, COUNT(*) AS submitCount FROM question_submit WHERE isDelete = 0 AND userId = #{userId} AND status IN (2, 3) GROUP BY status, message
